title: Cum funcționează
content:
un cadou atent, simplificat

Douăzeci și patru de scrisori frumos ilustrate, livrate pe parcursul a douăsprezece luni — un cadou care continuă să ofere.

  • CA CADOU

Pasul 1

Choose the story and steat date

With six stories to choose from, there is something for everyone. Choose your preferred ship date and set your gifting timeline. Be sure to use your recipient's address at checkout.

Pasul 2

Download your printable gift introduction

Print at home to present in person, or email it to a friend celebrating from afar. We give you choices —what's best for your gifting occasion?

 

GIFT TODAY

Pasul 3

Let the story unfold

We'll take it from there and ship the first letter (or letter/tin) on the date selected, followed by two letters each month for the next year.

 

Pasul 1

Choose the story and ship date

With six stories to choose from, there is something for everyone. Select your preferred story and ship date to begin your lunar story experience.

Pasul 2

Receive your first letter

Your first letter (or letter/tin) ships on your selected date and arrives within days. A beautiful beginning to your year of storytelling.

Pasul 3

Enjoy to the journey

Settle in and savor these lunar moments. Two letters arrive each month for the next year, bringing joy, enrichment, relief and connection straight to your door.

Cadoul Perfect

I bought the Audrey Rose letters for my mom for Mother's Day! She absolutely loves them. She calls me every time she knows they have been mailed and again when she received the letter. I just love seeing how excited she gets talking despre and waiting for the next letter. I found the perfect gift for her.

– Kelly M. 

A Joyful Experience

The combination of snail mail, mixed materials and a compelling story really resonated with me. It brought me back to a simpler time and allowed me to have an adventure in my wn kitchen. I love the idea of it being spread out over an entire year becuase it gave me something realluy special to look forward to. I have since gifted Flower Letters to two important people in my life so they can have the same joyful experience.

– Deborah S.

A Beautiful Escape

So enjoyable, relaxing, exciting that it comes in the mail, looking forward to each letter. Beautiful artistry and words. This era is Romantic! The items that give a person a true experience of the past–an escape for a while. Just beautiful!

 

– Christy M.
